_comment: RAM budgets for stemtape_player, enforced by
These are RATCHETS, not aspirations: each is set at or just above what
the image actually uses, so any growth fails the build and has to be
argued for in a diff. They come DOWN as the audit reclaims memory; they
do not go up without a stated reason in the commit that raises them.
TARGET, recorded here so it is not lost: 98304 bytes free (96 KiB), which
the analysis in src/st_latency.h shows is reachable only with a unified
sector cache at the adopted latency guarantee. min_free_bytes tracks what
is currently PROVEN, not the target.
fx: the one FX rack. 36864 is a RATCHET just above the 32,952 the rack
actually occupies -- 32,768 of it the single echo delay line. It is a
separate category precisely so the rack cannot hide inside the general
'stemtape' allowance: a second rack, or a stereo delay line, fails here.
